scenario: Back-face Super+LMB carry of a window in Lumen Reach: the 180 degree flip guarded by interaction::sweepSafe (nested --static-world, part 2).

machine.gpus: Intel iGPU drives the nested session (RTX 5090 Laptop GPU idle; offload off)

method: Each plugin build carried a temporary, uncommitted RAII timer at the top of Runtime::button: on a press it appended the handler's wall time (std::chrono::steady_clock, ms) to /tmp/hyprune-press-times.log.
Per run the reported value is the slowest press, the back-face grab (the other presses in the first baseline run took 0.02-0.03 ms).
Builds alternated before, remote fix, final, before, remote fix, final; every run passed all 14 static-world checks.

builds.label: before
builds.note: core main then: every collision triangle at every sweep step

reference: The remote work host measured the same press at 561 ms before the fix (commit 1705edc message).
